3 هاودهُ , (A,) inf. n. مُهَاوَدَةٌ. (S, A, L, K,) He made peace with him; reconciled himself with him; (A;) syn. of the inf. n. مُوَادَعَةٌ; (A, L;) in the K, مُوَاعَدَةٌ, which is a mistake; (TA;) and مُصَالَحَةٌ, (S, L,) and مُهَادَنَةٌ: (TA:) and also مُرَاجَعَةٌ [app. signifying the restoring a person, or taking him back, into one's favour]. (TA.) ―
-b2- He inclined towards him reciprocally; syn. مَايَلَهُ: and هَاوَدَا They two inclined each towards the other; syn. مَايَلَا: (TK:) syn. of the inf. n. مُمَايَلَةٌ. (S, L.) ―
-b3- He returned to him, or it, time after time; syn. عَاوَدَهُ: (TK:) syn. of the inf. n. مُعَاوَدَةٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
